title: Fox and Cyber Mandala
description: A red fox stands on a purple dune in the foreground, reaching toward a massive intricate cybernetic mandala structure that dominates the center. The background features stylized purple desert dunes under a swirling green, magenta and teal aurora sky with floating orbs and mechanical towers.
prompt: A red fox standing on its hind legs reaching up toward an enormous intricate biomechanical lotus mandala floating above a purple desert landscape, the mandala has glowing green and purple patterns with visible circuitry, behind it are stylized sand dunes under a dramatic swirling green magenta and teal aurora sky, floating holographic orbs and strange mechanical towers in the distance, surreal visionary art style, highly detailed, cinematic lighting
